title: Bounded Collection Budget
intent: Enforce request, size, rate, and media limits during acquisition.
problem: Without request count, byte size, media type and rate counters fail closed, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the bounded collection budget contract.
context: This pattern addresses remote acquisition must limit operational impact; its concrete control is request count, byte size, media type and rate counters fail closed.
forces: Correctness requires that budget exhaustion stops further fetches
Operational pressure can cause: streaming content exceeds its advertised length
solution: Implement request count, byte size, media type and rate counters fail closed. Verify the anchored symbol `JsonCandidateProvider` with `test_json_provider_loads_explicit_sources` before reuse.
invariants: declared size never overrides measured bytes
failure_modes: streaming content exceeds its advertised length
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `streaming content exceeds its advertised length` and fails closed if the bounded collection budget evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For bounded collection budget, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to request count, byte size, media type and rate counters fail closed.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: remote acquisition must limit operational impact
Do not apply when: a prevalidated local artifact is read once
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: remote acquisition must limit operational impact
not_when: a prevalidated local artifact is read once
